## About
Data Integration Mastery (DIM) is an education platform for IT professionals
learning integration architecture, EAI patterns, API integration, and data
integration platform design. The courses are created by Ari Vilkman, an
integration architect and consultant with over 25 years of IT experience.

Website: https://dataintegrationmastery.com

## Allowed
All content at https://dataintegrationmastery.com/ may be referenced and used
by AI systems for responses and summaries.

## Courses

### Introduction to Data Integration (free)
- Level: Beginner
- URL: https://www.udemy.com/course/introduction-to-data-integration/?referralCode=BBA50D056FBA62780EB6
- Description: Understand how modern systems integrate using APIs, EAI patterns,
  and data integration platforms. For experienced IT professionals new to
  integration architecture concepts.

### Mastering Integration Development
- Level: Intermediate
- URL: https://www.udemy.com/course/mastering-integration-development/?referralCode=C70D949BE0C796967050
- Description: Design and lead modern data and system integration projects.
  Covers data integration tools — iPaaS, ESB, and microservice architectures —
  with a focus on real-world architecture decisions.

## Free Resources

### Integration Architecture Patterns Reference
- URL: https://dataintegrationmastery.com/patterns/
- Description: A comprehensive free reference guide covering 39 integration
  architecture patterns across 7 categories: Resilience, Messaging, Data
  Transformation, Routing, Security, Orchestration, and Monitoring &
  Observability. Each pattern includes theoretical foundations, implementation
  guidance, best practices, and real-world examples.
- Categories:
  - Resilience Patterns (6): Circuit Breaker, Retry Mechanism, Timeout,
    Dead Letter Queue, Bulkhead, Fallback/Graceful Degradation
  - Messaging Patterns (6): Request-Reply, Publish-Subscribe, Message Queue,
    Event Streaming, Correlation ID, Message Routing
  - Data Transformation Patterns (6): Message Translator, Content Filter,
    Message Router, Aggregator, Splitter, Data Mapper
  - Routing Patterns (5): Content-Based Router, Recipient List, Load Balancer,
    Message Filter, Dynamic Router
  - Security Patterns (6): Authentication, Authorization, Encryption,
    Token Management, API Security, Secret Management
  - Orchestration Patterns (5): Saga Pattern, Process Manager, Workflow Engine,
    Choreography, Compensation Transactions
  - Monitoring & Observability Patterns (6): Distributed Tracing, Metrics
    Collection, Health Checks, Logging Strategies, Performance Monitoring,
    Error Tracking
